20157.ins: Four pieces is the complete nun kit on this site - headscarf, outfit, neck loop, thong - and the high slit is the one design liberty that separates this listing from the straight habit. Black polyester washes gentle and keeps its drape hung.
20157.short: Black nun costume with headscarf, neck loop, thong and high-slit skirt, four pieces, one size for 40-60 kg, authority-figure costume.

20215.ins: The double-tie inclusion - bow tie and straight tie both in the bag - lets the wearer choose the secretary flavor without a second purchase, and milk silk is the softest base in the role-play category. One size across 90-155 lbs.
20215.short: Milk-silk secretary set with strap skirt, bandeau top and two tie options, four pieces, one size for 90-155 lbs.

20452.ins: Dress-and-thong is the simplest complete entry in the cheongsam family that runs four listings deep here - for buyers who already know the silhouette and want it without accessory management. As-pictured colorway, one size for 40-60 kg.
20452.short: Classical Chinese cheongsam dress with matching thong in polyester, one size for 40-60 kg, two-piece costume set as pictured.

20460.ins: Three colorways is the joint-widest nurse run on the site, and the lace construction is what makes the hollow-out cut possible without hemming every edge - the fabric and the design are the same decision. One size for 40-60 kg.
20460.short: Hollow-out lace nurse uniform with skirt and hat in black, pink or white, one size for 40-60 kg, three-colorway costume set.

18990.ins: Cow print is the friendly entry in the animal genre - less commitment than leopard, more personality than solids - and the milk-silk lace base keeps it pajama-soft rather than costume-stiff. Black or pink, one size at 90-155 lbs.
18990.short: Cow-print pajama set in milk-silk lace with dress and sleeves, black or pink, one size for 90-155 lbs, soft animal-print sleepwear.

18996.ins: The hood does the bunny work - ears built in, theme carried at the head - and the sweatshirt format makes this the cold-night option in a category that usually demands skin. Backless below the hood keeps it honest about what it is.
18996.short: Hooded bunny sweatshirt with short skirt in milk silk, backless cut, one size for 90-155 lbs, cold-night costume sleepwear.

19053.ins: S and M by weight band with an elastic-fit construction that tolerates actual water - the cheongsam silhouette in swimsuit form is a crossover that works precisely because the fabric is swim-grade rather than costume-grade.
19053.short: Cheongsam-style cut-out swimsuit in black or white with elastic fit, S and M for 85-120 lbs, oriental-silhouette one-piece.

19250.ins: Blue is the authentic JK colorway and the bunny detail rides on the strap-skirt hardware rather than print - a quieter crossover than most. Four pieces in the clothing-only combo, breathable polyester for full-evening wear.
19250.short: Blue JK uniform set with bunny detail, four pieces from top to strap skirt, one size for 40-60 kg, breathable polyester.

20265.ins: Gray is the softest read in the school genre - softer than navy, less bridal than white - and the chiffon-mesh blend keeps the onesie sheer and breathing. The tie decoration at the throat is the JK identification, arrived with the garment.
20265.short: Gray preppy JK onesie in chiffon-mesh with tie decoration, sheer styling, one size for 40-60 kg, single-garment school aesthetic.

20506.ins: The V-strap line does the shaping that underwire would otherwise handle, and the lace trim finishes what the straps start - a one-piece that reads designed rather than assembled. Blue chiffon in one size, gifting-ready format.
20506.short: Blue chiffon one-piece lingerie with V-strap detail and lace trim, one size, breathable gifting-ready single piece for 40-60 kg.
